en.summary: A dislocated shoulder is painful and needs urgent clinical reduction — do not try to force it back yourself. NHS: support the arm, seek emergency care. Numbness, cool hand, or open injury raises urgency further.
emergencyIf: Shoulder deformity with severe pain after trauma
Numbness or cold hand after shoulder injury
selfCare: Support the arm in the most comfortable position while arranging emergency care
doNot: Do not try to shove the shoulder back in yourself
Do not invent sedation/reduction drug regimens

fr.summary: Une épaule luxée nécessite une réduction médicale urgente — ne pas forcer soi-même. Soutenir le bras ; urgences.
selfCare: Soutenir le bras en attendant les secours

he.summary: פריקת כתף דורשת החזרה רפואית דחופה — לא להחזיר לבד. לתמוך בזרוע; חירום.

ru.summary: Вывих плеча требует срочного вправления врачом — не вправлять самостоятельно. Поддержать руку; неотложка.
